title: LOS - loss of optical signal
shortDescription: Gateway receives no optical signal from the OLT - bent fiber, dirty connector, or ISP outage.
fullDescription:
The LOS LED on a Calix GigaCenter / GigaSpire goes solid red when the ONT cannot detect a light signal from the ISP's OLT. This means either the fiber is physically broken/disconnected, a connector is dirty, the fiber is bent below minimum radius, or there is an upstream outage.

LOS is the most common fiber fault homeowners encounter. Unlike copper, fiber has no tolerance for kinks or dirty connectors.

fixSteps.title: Check ISP outage
fixSteps.instruction: Call ISP before touching anything - outages are common.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fiber routing
fixSteps.instruction: Look for kinks, furniture pinching the cable, or pulled connectors. Never bend fiber tighter than a 1-inch radius.

fixSteps.title: Reseat SC/APC connector
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug, inspect green connector tip, clean with lint-free wipe if available, reinsert firmly until it clicks.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle ONT
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug the Calix for 30 seconds then reboot.

fixSteps.title: Schedule ISP tech
fixSteps.instruction: Any damaged fiber or broken connector needs a splice truck.

whenToCallPro: Any visible fiber damage, broken connector, or if reseating does not clear LOS.
videoSearchQuery: Calix GigaSpire LOS red light fix

faq.a: No - fiber splicing requires a fusion splicer and training. Call the ISP.

faq.q: How fragile is the fiber cable?
faq.a: Tighter than a 1-inch bend radius permanently damages the glass core.

title: PON link not established
shortDescription: Optical signal detected but PON session cannot be established with the OLT.
fullDescription: The ONT has optical power but cannot complete the PON registration handshake. Differs from LOS - light is present but communication fails. Often a provisioning issue or OLT-side mismatch.

fixSteps.title: Contact ISP
fixSteps.instruction: ISP must verify ONT serial on OLT provisioning.

faq.q: What's the difference between LOS and PON alarm?
faq.a: LOS means no light at all; PON alarm means light is present but session fails.

title: ONT failed registration with OLT
shortDescription: OLT did not accept this ONT's registration request.
fullDescription: After optical link is established, the ONT must register with the OLT using its serial number. If the OLT has not been told to expect this serial, registration fails. Common after an ONT swap.

fixSteps.title: Give ISP your ONT serial
fixSteps.instruction: Read serial number from sticker and provide to ISP for provisioning.

faq.a: On the bottom sticker, usually labeled SN or S/N, 12 characters.

title: ONT has no sync with OLT
shortDescription: PON LED never goes solid - no sync achieved.
fullDescription: Optical signal may be intermittent or weak. The ONT keeps attempting handshake but never completes. Usually a dirty connector or weak optical power.

fixSteps.title: Clean fiber connector
fixSteps.instruction: Use one-click cleaner or isopropyl-moistened lint-free wipe.

fixSteps.title: ISP optical power test
fixSteps.instruction: Ask ISP to measure Rx power - should be -8 to -27 dBm.

whenToCallPro: Weak Rx power needs splice/line work.

faq.q: How low is too low for Rx?
faq.a: Below -27 dBm is out of spec for GPON; most ONTs target -8 to -24 dBm.

title: Dying gasp - ONT lost power
shortDescription: ONT sent a dying-gasp PDU indicating imminent power loss.
fullDescription:
This is logged on the OLT, not shown on the device. It means the ONT detected input power loss and broadcasted a final message. A battery backup unit (BBU) can keep it alive briefly.

If you see this reported by your ISP, check the power brick, surge protector, or add a UPS/BBU.

fixSteps.title: Check outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Test another device on the same outlet.

fixSteps.title: Replace power brick
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm 12V DC adapter matches original rating.

fixSteps.title: Install UPS
fixSteps.instruction: A small UPS bridges short outages and prevents dying gasp.

faq.q: Does the ONT have an internal battery?
faq.a: No, but some models support an external BBU for VoIP continuity.

title: WiFi radio disabled or crashed
shortDescription: 2.4/5 GHz radios show as offline in GigaSpire app.
fullDescription: Calix GigaSpire units occasionally have a radio go offline after firmware updates. Wired works but WiFi is missing.

fixSteps.title: Check ventilation
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure unit is vertical and not in enclosed cabinet.

fixSteps.title: Ask ISP for firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Some versions have known radio bugs.

whenToCallPro: Radios die after every reboot - RMA needed.

faq.q: Can I add my own router?
faq.a: Yes - disable WiFi on Calix and plug your router into a LAN port.

title: VoIP port has no dial tone
shortDescription: Phone plugged into Tel port gets silence.
fullDescription: When the ONT's integrated ATA fails to register with the ISP's SIP server, phones on Tel1/Tel2 have no dial tone. Often after a firmware update or internet outage.

fixSteps.title: Unplug all phones
fixSteps.instruction: A shorted phone can kill dial tone on that port.

whenToCallPro: Confirmed SIP issue - ISP must re-register line.
videoSearchQuery: Calix ONT no dial tone VoIP

faq.q: Does phone work during power outage?
faq.a: Only if an external BBU is installed.

title: WAN DHCP lease not obtained
shortDescription: PON is up but ONT cannot get IP from ISP.
fullDescription: PON session is established, but WAN side fails DHCP. Usually a provisioning or VLAN issue.

faq.a: Only if ISP has a bridge profile provisioned.

title: Optical receive power below -27 dBm
shortDescription: Rx optical power is below GPON spec causing intermittent errors.
fullDescription: As splitters, splices and long drop lengths accumulate loss, Rx power drops. Below -27 dBm for GPON you see CRC errors and intermittent drops. Fix requires splice inspection or drop replacement.

fixSteps.title: Request OLT Rx check
fixSteps.instruction: ISP reads Rx power - if out of spec schedule tech.

whenToCallPro: Rx still low after cleaning - splice work needed.

faq.a: -8 to -24 dBm is good; below -27 is failing.

title: Cannot access admin - locked out
fullDescription: Calix gateways deployed by ISPs usually disable end-user admin access. The 192.168.1.1 page may not show advanced settings. Factory reset will not unlock these - they redeploy with the same profile.

fixSteps.title: Contact ISP
fixSteps.instruction: Ask for advanced mode or bridge mode activation.

fixSteps.title: Use own router
fixSteps.instruction: Put ISP gateway in bridge mode and add a personal router.

videoSearchQuery: Calix GigaSpire admin unlock bridge mode

faq.q: Can I replace it with my own ONT?
faq.a: Rarely - ISPs provision only specific models.
